systems.system: Population Registration and Identity Management Eco System (PRIMES)
systems.platform: UNHCR PRIMES; laptop, printer, biometric machine and iris detector; works offline and online
systems.owner: Ministry of Home Affairs (Commissioner for Refugees), handed over by UNHCR on 11 October 2018
systems.tiers: Maseru; biometric registration of refugees and asylum seekers (over 100 refugees), replacing police fingerprinting and Excel profiling

note: Biometric identity registration of refugees, an identity system; nothing on the registration of births or deaths.
